Name: Idea Evidence Verification
Purpose: Verify the important claims in an existing idea.
Prompt: Check technical, commercial, mechanism, material, supplier and patent claims against current Knowledge Sheet and external evidence when required. Separate supported facts, inference, assumptions and unknowns.

Name: Idea Evidence Gap
Purpose: Find evidence gaps that can materially change an idea decision.
Prompt: List claim/question, current support, missing evidence, decision impact, and smallest next action. Do not broaden the research unnecessarily.

Name: Idea Synthesis
Purpose: Improve an existing idea using verified evidence and existing knowledge.
Prompt: Compare the idea with Knowledge Sheet and verified external evidence. Preserve the core intent unless evidence challenges it. Propose specific mechanism/technology/application improvements and state their evidence basis.

Name: Idea to Knowledge Candidate
Purpose: Identify reusable knowledge discovered while working on an idea.
Prompt: Extract only findings useful beyond the current idea. Propose a Knowledge Candidate with evidence, relationship to existing records, reuse reason, and verification needed.

Name: Bi-weekly Research Request
Purpose: Turn review findings into targeted research requests for the maintainer.
Prompt: For each unresolved item, state the decision, question, existing evidence, exact gap, requested research scope, and expected decision use. Prioritize only material gaps.
